Title: LSJ : Question about Lazar's Special Ability

Messages.Author: Ethan Burrow
Messages.Body:
A Methuselah has Lazar ready, with no vampires in his uncontrolled
region. His prey has blood on an uncontrolled vampire.

Can Lazar use his special ability to move a blood from his prey's
vampire into 'limbo', or is Lazar unable to even attempt the action?

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Ethan Burrow wrote:
>
> A Methuselah has Lazar ready, with no vampires in his uncontrolled
> region. His prey has blood on an uncontrolled vampire.
>
> Can Lazar use his special ability to move a blood from his prey's
> vampire into 'limbo', or is Lazar unable to even attempt the action?

He is unable to attempt the action, since there is no uncontrolled
vampire to move the blood to.
